title: 87% of the Anthropic power will come from gas and 11% from coal in 2028
titleZh: 87% of the Anthropic power will come from gas and 11% from coal in 2028
author: happosai
relevanceReason: 命中 2 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: In The AI Gas Rush: Risks and Implications of “Bring Your Own Power”, we dug into how data centers are increasingly securing their own dedicated primary power generation rather than relying solely on utilities to procure power (“BYOP”). We identified 177 GW of planned BYOP gas capacity—enough to power 65% of all US homes. Conversely, we found renewables are much less common than gas for BYOP: we estimate that for current proposals, less than 20% of energy generation will come from renewable sources by 2032.

But BYOP projects aren’t the only new fossil sources that are coming online to meet the skyrocketing energy demands of AI data centers. Another 200 GW of new fossil power plants is being built on the grid to meet growing demand, due in large part to data centers.1
As a case study of how the AI buildout is driving both new BYOP and grid fossil infrastructure, we analyzed the compute commitments of a single company: Anthropic.
Map of Anthropic’s data centers and associated power plants. See our full dataset for details of each site.
Figure 1. Breakdown of power source for Anthropic’s compute.

Just clearly not a priority, and they should be shamed and pressured. They know better.

children.author: olladecarne
children.textRawHtml: This is just part of the RSI-endgame, isn't it? Basically Anthropic started because they thought this is a winner-take-all singularity moment. They know it can end humanity, and are worried others will take shortcuts to get there. But in the process they take as many shortcuts that they decide are ok to take, which forces others to also take shortcuts. But they tell themselves that their shortcuts are ok because the they are the chosen ones, and the other companies also tell themselves the same story. Then we all die because some of the shortcuts actually led to doom and it turned out none of the humans were gods.
